import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); out=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'logs'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from evaluate_cuda_math import source_provenance
from evaluate_cuda_transfers import evaluator_hashes
name,*cmd=sys.argv[1:]
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True)
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
status=git('status','--porcelain=v1')
assert not status,status
source=source_provenance(); hashes=evaluator_hashes()
assert source['commit']=='dc2366727f7839e8710af48fd63b08268d40f987'
r={'command':cmd,'cwd':str(root),'started_at_utc':now(),'source_before':source,'evaluator_hashes_before':hashes,'status_before':status,'environment':{k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith(('CARGO_','UV_','CUDA_','TORCH','TRITON_','PYO3_','RUSTUP_')) or k in ('TMPDIR','XDG_CACHE_HOME','VIRTUAL_ENV','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE','LD_LIBRARY_PATH','GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS')},'unset_environment':[k for k in ('PYTHONPATH','PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX','CONDA_PREFIX') if k not in os.environ]}
start=time.monotonic()
with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as f:
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
r.update(ended_at_utc=now(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,exit_code=p.returncode,source_after=source_provenance(),evaluator_hashes_after=evaluator_hashes(),status_after=git('status','--porcelain=v1'),log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((out/(name+'.log')).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
(out/(name+'.receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
assert r['source_after']==source and r['evaluator_hashes_after']==hashes and not r['status_after']
print(name,'exit',p.returncode,'seconds',round(r['elapsed_seconds'],2)); print((out/(name+'.log')).read_text()[-3500:])
sys.exit(p.returncode)

(work/'build-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(build,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'source':source_provenance(),'extension_path':str(extension),'extension_sha256':sha256(extension),'installed_extension_path':str(installed),'wheel_sha256':sha256(wheel)},indent=2))

verify.py.source:
import datetime,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); work=root/'target/composite-postcommit-dc236672'; venv=work/'venv'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import evaluate_cuda_transfers as evaluator
from evaluate_cuda_math import source_provenance,sha256
r=json.loads((work/'transfers.json').read_text()); build=json.loads((work/'build-record.json').read_text())
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1'],text=True)
assert r['source']==source_provenance()
assert r['source']['commit']=='dc2366727f7839e8710af48fd63b08268d40f987'
assert r['source_unchanged_during_run'] and r['evaluator_hashes']==evaluator.evaluator_hashes()==build['evaluator_hashes']
assert r['build_record']==build
assert all(build[k]==r['source'][k] for k in r['source'])
assert len(r['seeds'])==3 and len(set(r['seeds']))==3
assert len(r['trials'])==18
accounting=evaluator.account(evaluator.corpus(),r['seeds'],r['trials'],build,r['source'])
assert r['accounting']==accounting
assert accounting['denominator']==accounting['passed']==6
runtime_paths=set(); worker_paths=set()
for trial in r['trials']:
    assert trial['reference']['pid']!=trial['candidate']['pid']
    for role in ('reference','candidate'):
        row=trial[role]
        case=next(c for c in evaluator.corpus()['cases'] if c['id']==trial['case_id'])
        assert evaluator.valid_execution(row,case,trial['seed'],role)
        assert pathlib.Path(row['executable'])==venv/'bin/python'
        assert pathlib.Path(row['executable']).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
        package=pathlib.Path(row['package']); worker_paths.add(str(package))
        assert package.is_relative_to(venv if role=='reference' else root/'python')
        assert row['cuda_runtimes']
        assert row['TORCH_RS_CUDART']==os.environ['TORCH_RS_CUDART']
        for rt in row['cuda_runtimes']:
            assert pathlib.Path(rt['path']).resolve().is_relative_to(venv)
            assert rt['version']==13000 and rt['status']==0
            runtime_paths.add(rt['path'])
        if role=='candidate':
            assert not row['blocked_imports'] and not row['loaded_torch_modules']
            assert row['extension']['path']==build['extension_path']
            assert sha256(row['extension']['path'])==row['extension']['sha256']==build['extension_sha256']
        else:
            assert row['version']=='2.13.0+cu130' and row['pytorch_cuda']=='13.0'
            assert row['gpu']['name']=='NVIDIA H100' and row['gpu']['compute_capability']==[9,0]
assert sha256(build['installed_extension_path'])==build['extension_sha256']
assert sha256(build['wheel_path'])==build['wheel_sha256']
receipts=[]
for path in sorted((work/'logs').glob('*.receipt.json')):
    receipt=json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert receipt['exit_code']==0 and not receipt['status_before'] and not receipt['status_after']
    assert receipt['source_before']==receipt['source_after']==r['source']
    assert receipt['evaluator_hashes_before']==receipt['evaluator_hashes_after']==r['evaluator_hashes']
    assert sha256(path.with_name(path.name.replace('.receipt.json','.log')))==receipt['log_sha256']
    receipts.append(path.name)
audit=json.loads((work/'candidate-audit.json').read_text())
for row in audit['changed_files']:assert sha256(root/row['path'])==row['sha256']
verified={'verified_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source':r['source'],'evaluator_hashes':r['evaluator_hashes'],'accounting':accounting,'seeds':r['seeds'],'raw_report_sha256':sha256(work/'transfers.json'),'build_record_sha256':sha256(work/'build-record.json'),'extension_sha256':build['extension_sha256'],'wheel_sha256':build['wheel_sha256'],'runtime_library_hashes':{p:sha256(p) for p in sorted(runtime_paths)},'actual_worker_package_paths':sorted(worker_paths),'clean_receipts_verified':receipts,'clean_status_after_all_measurements':'','candidate_torch_imports':[],'all_initial_candidate_files_unchanged':True,'all_worker_paths_inside_current_composite':True,'all_runtime_paths_inside_fresh_environment':True}
(work/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(verified,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: all 6 fixed cases at all 3 seeds; all 18 trials independently revalidated.')
print('Seeds:',r['seeds']);print('Source:',r['source'])
print('Clean build/run receipts, fresh local imports/runtime, and extension/evaluator hashes verified.')
